## Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`)

### Status
Completed

### Summary of Changes

1. **Op Types and Models ([`internal/core/ops/op.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/op.go))**:
   - Defined `OpType` string enum with all 6 v2 operations: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.
   - Defined `Op` struct targeting entries by `EntryID` with scope, timestamp, provenance source, session ID, and type-specific payload `Fields`.
   - Defined `OpBatch` struct with schema versioning, batch ID (ULID), and creation timestamp.

2. **File I/O ([`internal/core/ops/writer.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/writer.go), [`internal/core/ops/reader.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/reader.go))**:
   - `Writer.Write(batch)`: Writes indented JSON batches sharded by month (`.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json`).
   - `Reader.ReadBatch(path)`: Reads and deserializes an individual batch file with validation.

3. **Op Log Iterator ([`internal/core/ops/iterator.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/iterator.go))**:
   - `Reader.Iterate`: Yields `iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]` across monthly directory shards in strictly chronological ULID order.
   - `Reader.IterateAfter`: Supports incremental consumption after a specific batch ULID.
   - `Reader.IterateBefore`: Implements time-cut resolution based on git commit timestamp (`git log -1 --format=%cI`).

4. **Validation ([`internal/core/ops/validate.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/validate.go))**:
   - Strict validation rules per op type (`add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`) with clear error messaging.
   - Batch-level validation verifying version, batch ID, timestamps, and non-empty ops.

5. **v1 Events Migration & Deprecation ([`internal/core/ops/migrate.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/migrate.go), [`internal/core/events/doc.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/events/doc.go))**:
   - `MigrateV1Events`: Handles moving `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.
   - Added deprecation notice to `events` package documentation.

6. **Test Suite ([`internal/core/ops/ops_test.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-pa_documents-seed256/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go))**:
   - Comprehensive unit and integration test coverage across validation, serialization round-tripping, chronological iteration, git time-cuts, and v1 migration.
